. Protein powders are
an easy way to turn a fruit smoothie or a bowl of oatmeal into a balanced
breakfast. Suzy, a vegetarian fitness exerciser, chose protein supplements
because they eliminated guesswork; the label told her exactly how much
protein she would consume. In today's grab-and-go fast-food society,
protein supplements are a mindless way to get seemingly healthy (low-fat)
protein. In the case of missed meals, any protein is better than no protein,
so keeping a protein bar handy for emergency food is a wise choice. My
advice is to use them to supplement wise eating, not to replace it.

That said, protein supplements can be helpful in a few medical situations,
such as for malnourished patients with AIDS or cancer. Protein supplements
can benefit people with anorexia who have cut out animal products as a
way to eliminate calories from their diets.
